sample.design: Stratified fixed-seed discovery sample; 125 separate threads, not representative prevalence.
sample.stages: Target review frozen first; earlier context and later same-thread observations separate.
limits: Lossy privacy redaction; original selected requests may be misread or withheld.
No inbound attachment contents or independent current-HMS truth in this sample.
Later staff text can reflect another message; it is not proof of a saved HMS or money outcome.
Censored or absent replies do not establish that no response occurred.
These case notes are evidence for tool discovery, not production accuracy or policy.
Target projections provide a stable envelope but preserve different reviewer vocabularies; do not aggregate their codes as a shared ontology.

post_freeze_correction.disagreement: Frozen lane label calls this an added night. The coordinator's less-redacted target projection indicates the guest requested a later arrival than the described booked arrival and said an extra night was already added; this suggests removing that night. The independent reviewer rechecked its stricter projection and agreed the extension direction was unverified. HMS and the attachment are not verified; the original frozen label is preserved.
